purpose: First-pass curation metadata for deciding which Flash UI assets should be polished, shared, embedded, promoted, deployed, or archived. This file is additive and must not rename folders, rewrite the registry, or change livePath values.

scoreMeaning.1: Low priority / archive only unless specifically needed
scoreMeaning.2: Rough prototype / useful concept but needs heavy review
scoreMeaning.3: Viable internal asset / needs polish before public sharing
scoreMeaning.4: Strong candidate / worth polishing or embedding
scoreMeaning.5: Priority asset / ready or near-ready for promotion

curationSchema.slug: Registry slug or stable inferred slug.
curationSchema.title: Human-readable asset title.

defaultScores.recommendedNextAction: Review logic, CTA, and compliance language; then promote strongest version as a lead magnet.
Polish copy and convert into partner-shareable campaign asset or Wix embed.
Test iframe behavior and create embed instructions for Wix/partner use.
Curate best agent concepts and package into an internal prompt/library resource.
Review content architecture and decide whether to merge into existing content/SEO properties.
Audit build strategy and decide whether this should remain in portfolio or move to a dedicated deployment/repo.
Keep archived until a specific promotion or extraction reason exists.
